title: The Magic Forest Adventure
description: A young girl discovers magical creatures in an enchanted forest

scenes.text: A brave young girl with long hair explores a mystical forest filled with glowing trees.
She discovers a friendly dragon with rainbow wings sitting by a crystal lake.
The girl and dragon fly together above the magical forest under a starry sky.
